title: failure
description: A failure that the supervisor saw: one thread for each session and reason. A new try posts a new failure in the thread; a recovery posts the state recovered.

text.description: One line for people: what failed.

reason.description: failed-turns: the supervisor turns of the session fail. no-ack: the live session takes no input.

state.description: open: the failure continues. recovered: the session works again.

tries.description: The count of failed tries in this failure.

first.description: The time of the first failed try (ISO).

last.description: The time of the last failed try (ISO).

next.description: The time of the next try (ISO), if the supervisor waits.

envelopes.description: The envelopes that wait for the session.
